sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the required plating-owned operands, units, piecewise f2 formula and expected-value-scaled tolerance; the mutually exclusive steel-grade branches with required yield-strength and approval logic; and the 2 mm versus approved maintained-coating corrosion alternatives. Prior repair instructions are satisfied.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the yield-strength alternatives so missing or ambiguous steel-grade selection cannot pass: require exactly one hullStructuralSteelGrade on each targeted plating. Encode normal-strength steel as exactly 235 MPa using equal sh:minInclusive/sh:maxInclusive bounds, and high-strength steel as at least 315 MPa.
